title: Skyharbor
tagline: Find worlds, build harbour cities, raise wonders the whole galaxy travels to see.
description: Scan the Lantern Cluster for planets — ocean, desert, ice, jungle, volcanic, crystal and gas-giant moons — each with traits like auroras, twin moons, great tides or low gravity. Settle them, lay roads, homes, hotels and spaceports, then raise one of twelve hand-built wonders: a floating ring gate, a spiral crystal helix, a tidal-glass cathedral, an orbital elevator and more. Traits multiply what tourists love, ships arc in from six old civilisations, reviews float up, and every wonder has its own after-dark moment. Make Skyharbor the most-visited world in the cluster, or play in sandbox.
controls: Mouse: left-drag pan · right-drag rotate · wheel zoom · click to build or inspect. Touch: drag, pinch, two-finger twist. Keys: WASD/arrows pan · Q/E rotate · R/F tilt · 1–9 tools · L wonders · O overlay · V visit · T tourism · G goals · M galaxy · Space pause · Esc menu.
fablePass: Music: ambient bed per planet type, wonder-completion fanfare, festival theme
Wonder completion cinematic: choreographed camera + scaffold collapse
Visitor ship landing/take-off animation (gear, thrusters, dust) and crowd walk cycles
Construction cranes and scaffold animation for buildings and wonders
Per-landmark ambient sound (Helix hum, falls, lantern crackle)
